policies: A complete character render replaces the base illustration; it must not be mislabeled as hair-only.
Semantic image masks are experimental until their edges and compatibility are visually approved.
Layered PSD/XCF sources can preserve exact source canvas offsets when each layer is exported to the full canvas.
A flattened web image cannot reveal pixels hidden behind hair or clothing; masked areas may need to be redrawn manually.
Track source URL, author, license, source file hash, dimensions, alignment and review status.
